close_reason: False positive: lifecycle.rs handles Command::Hdr with continue before dispatch is reached. handle_hdr_live() correctly returns 430 for unknown msgids.
description: Trigger: client sends HDR Subject <msgid> where the message-id is known or unknown. Expected per RFC 3977 §8.5.3: 430 No Article With That Message-ID when the article is absent. Actual: dispatch.rs branch Command::Hdr { range_or_msgid: Some(msgid), .. } where msgid starts with '<' returns Response::hdr_follows(vec\![]) — 225 with empty body — regardless of whether the article exists. Clients that use HDR for article deduplication receive a false empty-list success.
title: HDR <msgid> returns 225 empty body instead of 430
